slides.title: Read three things
items: Evidence profile: the facts for each problem.
Proposed ranking: the agent's order, with a reason for each.
Flag report: what the agent stopped on. Your decisions go here.

slides.title: The manager loop
items: Write the brief. Set quality checks. Set hand-off rules.
Run.
Review the flag report and the proposed ranking.
Audit a sample.
Tune the brief.
Run again.
slides.visual_todo: Circle of 8 steps. "Audit a sample" and "Tune the brief" in orange. Marker: "You are here: lab 1".

slides.title: How the agent reports the evidence
items: Interviews (count interviews, not quotes). Accounts, segments, personas.
Urgency: the agent shows one quote.
Pervasiveness: the agent counts accounts and segments.
Willingness to pay clues: the agent lists them.
Source dates. Source type: PM-held interview (AI-moderated, where a team uses them).
Fact labels: "single source" (1 interview, however many quotes). "one segment only".
slides.callout: No magic number. Priority is relative.
